title: The matrix of a 90° rotation
caption: The columns of the matrix are where e₁ and e₂ land: (1, 0) goes to (0, 1) and (0, 1) goes to (−1, 0), giving [[0, −1], [1, 0]]. The unit square turns a quarter turn about the origin and keeps its area.
alt: The unit square in the first quadrant and its image in the second quadrant after an anticlockwise quarter turn about the origin.
description: e₁ = (1, 0) goes to (0, 1) and e₂ = (0, 1) goes to (−1, 0): these are the matrix columns.
The image has corners (0, 0), (0, 1), (−1, 1), (−1, 0): the square turned 90° anticlockwise.
